description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of answer types for a set of mathematical problems. The chart contains three slices representing “Open-Answer” (244), “Multi-Choice” and “True-False”. The “Open-Answer” slice is colored green and occupies approximately 63.0% of the chart. The “Multi-Choice” slice is colored orange and represents approximately 32.8% of the chart. The “True-False” slice is colored blue and accounts for roughly 4.1% of the chart. The chart includes percentage labels displayed inside each slice, and a legend identifying each answer type. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise from largest to smallest proportion.
